Convert landscape metrics from long to wide format

Source: R/nn_utils.R
metrics_to_wide.Rd

This function transforms landscape metrics from a long format to a wide format that is needed to train nn models

Usage

metrics_to_wide(metrics, return_only_metrics = FALSE)

Arguments

metrics

A data frame containing landscape metrics in long format. Expected columns include: `metric`, `class`, `id`, `value`, `pattern`. Must include either `landscape_id` or `landscape_name` for identification.

return_only_metrics

Logical. Whether to return only the metrics or also the the identification columns in output (default: FALSE).

Value

A data frame in wide format where each metric becomes a column and each row is a landscape. Metric names are modified to include class and patch IDs when applicable (format: `metric_class_id`).
